t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the number of points given depends on the gnomes, pink long haired gnome gives more than blue and green short gnome gives more than orange but sometimes it can go the opposite way so change it up if you notice them starting to give less points.

vb_textbox.text: I found that it didn't really matter what colour/size of gnome I chose, I think the ones on the right side of my screen tended to give more points. I mainly chose that side but then, if they started to give less points I would switch it up and chose the ones on the left instead for more points. I found that the 'x5' were more on the right side and I mainly chose the left side for the 'x1' ones.
